notes.title: Minor changes, but important.
notes.content:
Improved visibility of the bounce direction indicator. 
The algorithm calculating game progress has been changed. 
Thank you all for your comments and opinions.

notes.title: New language packs.
notes.content:
We have introduced new language packs. Currently available languages ​​are:
- English,
- Polish,
- German,
- French,
- Spanish,
- Russian,
- Czech,
- Portuguese

notes.title: New options.
notes.content:
In the latest update, we added new language packs and new menu options. The bloom intensity parameter can be adjusted in three levels. The option is available from the pause menu. Below are examples of how to use this function. What do you think?

notes.title: Game level balance has been improved.
notes.content:
The game was expanded with new levels and the game level balance was adjusted based on testers' opinions. We continue to refine the gameplay so that it will be perfect on launch day. Thank you for your advice and tips.
